title: Replit uses GPT-5.6 Luna to power a no-token-cost planning mode
friendlyTitle: Replit adds a free way to plan software ideas
summary: Replit’s Free Mode uses GPT-5.6 Luna for project-aware planning, questions, feedback, and analysis without consuming user usage, while harder tasks can be routed to GPT-5.6 Sol before returning to the same project context.
friendlySummary: Replit Free Mode uses GPT-5.6 Luna to help people plan and improve app ideas without using their token allowance.
whyItMatters: Separating free exploration from paid building can let more people shape an application before spending usage, while model routing illustrates a practical way to reserve expensive intelligence for the hardest steps.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can explore an idea before paying for the harder work of building it.
